english.title: Give false / misleading statement to weights and measures inspector exercising section 198 power
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in giving to **(..SPECIFY THE OFFICER..), a weights and measures officer, information required by the officer exercising a power under section 198 of the Legal Services Act 2007, made a statement which you knew to be false or misleading in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FALSE OR MISLEADING STATEMENT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 198(8)(d) and (9) of the Legal Services Act 2007
